'''Garen IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near [[Hargeeva]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was the location of an [[Imperial penal colony]].

[[Stevan Makintay]] was imprisoned at Garen IV by his father, who disapproved of his son's proposed marriage to [[Ketrian Altronel]].
